hero.label: Made for Sales
hero.headline: I want to be your first great SDR hire.
hero.subheadline: Early-stage sales is where I thrive: I helped an AI startup land 15 to 20 paying clients from cold outreach alone, and I want to bring that same scrappiness to your pipeline. There is something about being in the room where the go-to-market motion gets built from scratch that genuinely excites me, and that is exactly where this role sits.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage means every rep shapes the entire sales playbook
whyCompany.body: At a startup this early, the SDR is not executing a handed-down script. They are discovering what messaging lands, which channels convert, and who the real buyer is. That kind of ownership is rare and it is exactly the environment where I do my best work.

whyCompany.title: The timing to join a founding sales team is right now
whyCompany.body: The best time to join an early startup sales team is before the process is frozen and the playbook is locked. Getting in at this stage means my learning curve and the company's growth curve move together. That alignment is something I am actively looking for as I finish my degree in May 2026.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this exact job at an AI startup
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built cold outreach sequences from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn, and converted those conversations into 15 to 20 paying clients with no prior playbook to follow. At NextAfter I added B2B digital marketing strategy to that foundation, so I understand both how to start the conversation and how the broader revenue funnel works.

quote: I am not looking for a structured program or a big enablement team. I want a founder who will hand me a list, a problem, and the autonomy to go figure it out. That is the version of this job I am genuinely excited to show up for.
